sessions.phase_label: Mechanical design revision and drawing preparation
Final drawing review and deliverable preparation

requirements.title: ČSN/EN Drawing Standard Compliance
requirements.definition: The manufacturing drawings must comply with the applicable usual ČSN/EN drafting standards.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers standards compliance only; the supplied template, visual presentation, dimensions, and file formats are independently changeable requirements.

requirements.title: Drawing Template and Layout Setup
requirements.definition: The drawings must follow the setup and layout demonstrated by the client's supplied Inventor template and example.
requirements.boundary_note: The Inventor material establishes the expected drawing setup, not necessarily the required native authoring format; final CAD file formats are handled separately.

requirements.title: 3D Model File Package
requirements.definition: Provide the completed assembly and part models in the client-confirmed exchange and native editable 3D CAD formats.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers model-file formats and editable model artifacts; drawing exports and drawing approval sequencing are a separate delivery mechanism.

requirements.title: Part Material Selection
requirements.definition: Assign and document the specified engineering material for each part, including the distinct bushing material.
requirements.boundary_note: The per-part material mapping is one coordinated specification; individual material values are attributes rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Main Shaft Fabrication Process
requirements.definition: Define the main shaft's raw stock, premachining, welding, and final machining sequence, including required internal machining after welding.
requirements.boundary_note: Raw tube selection and the premachine-weld-final-machine sequence form one coupled shaft-fabrication mechanism; local face finishing, bushing retention, and keyway features can change independently.

requirements.title: Bushing Guidance and Retention Arrangement
requirements.definition: Define how the bushing is positioned, retained, fitted, and used to guide the control-piston rod within the shaft assembly.
requirements.boundary_note: Retention, sliding contact, fit, and rod guidance are tightly coupled aspects of the disputed bushing mechanism; bushing-hole geometry and bushing length remain separately inspectable details.

requirements.title: Assembly-Aligned Drawing Numbering
requirements.definition: Number individual drawings consistently with the position numbering shown on the assembly.
requirements.boundary_note: Drawing numbering is independently changeable without altering the assembly geometry or file package.

requirements.title: Main Shaft Keyway Omission
requirements.definition: Omit the keyway indicated at cross section C-C from the main shaft design.
requirements.boundary_note: This omission applies to the main shaft and must remain separate from the required keyway on the sliding mandrel.

requirements.title: Main Shaft Locking Interface Geometry
requirements.definition: Configure the M72x1.5 locking-nut thread and adjacent main-bushing space to the specified axial geometry.
requirements.boundary_note: Thread width and bushing-space length are parameters of one adjacent locking-interface mechanism rather than standalone Requirements.

requirements.title: Lug Hole Angular Spacing
requirements.definition: Arrange the relevant hole axes around the assembly with the client-specified angular separation.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the angular placement of the hole axes, not the separate manufacturing sequence used to form and weld the associated parts.

requirements.title: Pre-Weld Finishing of Surfaces 1 and 2
requirements.definition: Finish both identified mating surfaces before welding and do not machine either surface after welding.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a local manufacturing constraint for two faces and can change independently of the broader main-shaft machining sequence.

requirements.title: Bushing and Sliding-Mandrel Hole Retention
requirements.definition: Retain the existing holes in both the bushing and the sliding mandrel.
requirements.boundary_note: Hole retention is a discrete geometry decision and does not determine how the bushing is fitted or retained.

requirements.title: Thread Relief Groove
requirements.definition: Retain a small relief groove between the thread and bearing surface, subject to clarification of its final width.
requirements.boundary_note: The groove's existence is established, but its final width remains unresolved; it is separate from thread width and the bushing-space dimension.

requirements.title: Surface Finish and Tolerance Callout
requirements.definition: Apply the client-selected surface-finish value together with the specified tolerance field to the relevant drawing feature.
requirements.boundary_note: The finish value and its tolerance field form one callout; the supplied text does not identify the target feature clearly enough to broaden this to all surfaces.

requirements.title: Sliding Mandrel Keyway
requirements.definition: Include the required keyway groove on the sliding mandrel.
requirements.boundary_note: The sliding-mandrel keyway has its own failure and correction trajectory and is distinct from the keyway explicitly omitted from the main shaft.

requirements.title: Drawing View Color Scheme
requirements.definition: Keep ordinary drawing views uncoloured while permitting colour in the 3D views.
requirements.boundary_note: Visual colour treatment can be modified independently of drawing standards, geometry, dimensions, and export formats.

requirements.title: Manufacturing Drawing File Package
requirements.definition: Provide the finalized manufacturing drawings in the confirmed PDF and editable exchange formats, with PDF review occurring before final exports are released.
requirements.boundary_note: Export formats and the PDF-first approval sequence are attributes of one drawing-delivery mechanism; native 3D model files are handled separately.

requirements.title: Drawing Dimension Content and Integrity
requirements.definition: Show the required functional dimensions clearly, preserve useful overall dimensions appropriately, and maintain valid associations for reference dimensions.
requirements.boundary_note: Functional, overall, and reference dimensions are coordinated attributes of drawing dimension integrity; mechanical geometry decisions such as keyways and fits remain separate Requirements.

unresolved_candidates.description: The thread-relief groove must remain, but the client does not establish its final width.
The selected 6.3 surface-finish value is clear, but the supplied text does not identify the exact feature or surface receiving the callout.
The bushing arrangement is provisionally specified, but bushing length and possible later maintenance-manager revisions remain unresolved.
